quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert critiques Trae Young's shot selection and playstyle
quotes.excerpt: There is zero chance that Trae Young needs to go a whole game and shoot two threes.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: There is zero chance that Trae Young needs to go a whole game and shoot two threes. You are not going to get the layups that you used to get if you do not shoot that three that you usually shoot. If LaMelo doesn't shoot the one-foot step-back fall-away three and make it a couple of times, if he can't carry that threat, then that same dribble that he does to the step-back and then he throws it out and wipes and goes to the cup, he is not going to get it because we are not going to go for it.
